# Unified Notation and Conventions

This note is the canonical notation registry for the project. Chapters may
introduce local symbols, but they must not redefine symbols listed here. When a textbook uses different notation, translate it into these conventions.

## Core conventions

1. Scalars use italic lowercase letters, vectors use bold lowercase letters,
   and matrices use bold uppercase letters.
2. Vectors are column vectors unless stated otherwise.
3. SI units are used in calculations. Angles are expressed in radians.
4. Coordinate frames are right-handed. A leading left superscript identifies
   the frame in which coordinates are expressed.
5. Continuous time uses $t$; sampled time uses the integer index $k$.
6. Subscripts such as $\mathrm{ref}$, $\mathrm{cmd}$, $\min$, and $\max$
   describe roles rather than coordinate frames.
7. A hat, as in $\hat{\mathbf{x}}$, is reserved for an estimated quantity.

## Phase 1 notation

### General mathematics and time

| Symbol | Meaning | Units or convention |
|---|---|---|
| $a,\alpha$ | Scalar quantity | Depends on the quantity |
| $\mathbf{v}\in\mathbb{R}^n$ | Column vector with $n$ components | Depends on the quantity |
| $\mathbf{A}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ | Matrix with $m$ rows and $n$ columns | Depends on the map |
| $\mathcal{S}$ | Set or mathematical space | — |
| $\mathbf{I}_n$ | $n\times n$ identity matrix | Dimensionless |
| $\mathbf{0}_n$ | Zero vector with $n$ components | Depends on the quantity |
| $(\cdot)^\mathsf{T}$ | Transpose | — |
| $(\cdot)^{-1}$ | Inverse, when it exists | — |
| $\lVert\mathbf{v}\rVert_2$ | Euclidean norm of $\mathbf{v}$ | Same units as $\mathbf{v}$ |
| $t$ | Continuous time | $\mathrm{s}$ |
| $t_k$ | Time at sample $k$ | $\mathrm{s}$ |
| $\Delta t=t_{k+1}-t_k$ | Sampling or numerical-integration interval | $\mathrm{s}$ |
| $\dot{\mathbf{x}},\ddot{\mathbf{x}}$ | First and second derivatives with respect to time | Quantity per $\mathrm{s}$ and per $\mathrm{s}^2$ |
| $\mathbf{x}_k$ | Value of $\mathbf{x}$ at sample $k$ | Same units as $\mathbf{x}$ |

### Frames, geometry, and kinematics

| Symbol | Meaning | Units or convention |
|---|---|---|
| $\{a\}$ | Coordinate frame named $a$ | Right-handed |
| $O_a$ | Origin of frame $\{a\}$ | — |
| $\mathbf{e}_{x,a},\mathbf{e}_{y,a},\mathbf{e}_{z,a}$ | Unit basis vectors of frame $\{a\}$ | Dimensionless |
| ${}^{a}\mathbf{v}$ | Coordinates of geometric vector $\mathbf{v}$ expressed in frame $\{a\}$ | Depends on $\mathbf{v}$ |
| ${}^{a}\mathbf{p}_P$ | Position of point $P$ relative to $O_a$, expressed in frame $\{a\}$ | $\mathrm{m}$ |
| $\mathbf{R}_{ab}$ | Rotation mapping coordinates from frame $\{b\}$ to frame $\{a\}$ | $\mathbf{R}_{ab}\in SO(2)$ or $SO(3)$ |
| ${}^{a}\mathbf{p}_b$ | Position of origin $O_b$ relative to $O_a$, expressed in frame $\{a\}$ | $\mathrm{m}$ |
| $\mathbf{T}_{ab}$ | Homogeneous transform mapping coordinates from frame $\{b\}$ to frame $\{a\}$ | $\mathbf{T}_{ab}\in SE(2)$ or $SE(3)$ |
| $[\mathbf{v}]_\times$ | Skew-symmetric matrix satisfying $[\mathbf{v}]_\times\mathbf{w}=\mathbf{v}\times\mathbf{w}$ | Same units as $\mathbf{v}$ |
| $\mathbf{q}$ | Robot configuration or generalised coordinates | Components may have different units |
| $\mathbf{J}(\mathbf{q})$ | Jacobian mapping configuration rates to a specified task velocity | Depends on the mapping |

### Differential-drive motion and mechanics

| Symbol | Meaning | Units or convention |
|---|---|---|
| $\{w\},\{b\}$ | World and robot body frames | — |
| $\mathbf{q}=[x,y,\theta]^\mathsf{T}$ | Planar robot pose in the world frame | $\mathrm{m},\mathrm{m},\mathrm{rad}$ |
| $\theta$ | Counter-clockwise heading of $\{b\}$ relative to $\{w\}$ | $\mathrm{rad}$ |
| $v,\omega$ | Body-forward speed and yaw rate | $\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}},\mathrm{rad\,s^{-1}}$ |
| $\phi_L,\phi_R$ | Left and right wheel angles | $\mathrm{rad}$ |
| $\dot{\phi}_L,\dot{\phi}_R$ | Left and right wheel angular speeds | $\mathrm{rad\,s^{-1}}$ |
| $r,L$ | Wheel radius and distance between wheel contact lines | $\mathrm{m}$ |
| $m$ | Robot mass | $\mathrm{kg}$ |
| $\mathbf{F}$ | Force | $\mathrm{N}$ |
| $\boldsymbol{\tau}$ | Torque | $\mathrm{N\,m}$ |
| $I_z$ | Yaw moment of inertia about the body vertical axis | $\mathrm{kg\,m^2}$ |
| $\mu$ | Coefficient of friction | Dimensionless |

### Dynamics, control, limits, and verification

| Symbol | Meaning | Units or convention |
|---|---|---|
| $\mathbf{x}(t)$ | System state | Declared with each model |
| $\mathbf{u}(t)$ | Applied control input | Declared with each model |
| $\mathbf{d}(t)$ | External disturbance or unmodelled input | Declared with each model |
| $\dot{\mathbf{x}}=\mathbf{f}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{u},\mathbf{d},t)$ | Continuous-time state model | Units must be consistent |
| $\mathbf{x}_{k+1}=\mathbf{f}_d(\mathbf{x}_k,\mathbf{u}_k,\mathbf{d}_k,\Delta t)$ | Discrete-time state update | Units must be consistent |
| $\mathbf{x}_{\mathrm{ref}}$ | Desired or reference state | Same units as $\mathbf{x}$ |
| $\mathbf{e}=\mathbf{x}_{\mathrm{ref}}-\mathbf{x}$ | Tracking error; angular components must be wrapped | Same units as $\mathbf{x}$ |
| $\mathbf{u}_{\mathrm{cmd}}$ | Controller-requested input before limits | Same units as $\mathbf{u}$ |
| $\operatorname{sat}(\mathbf{u}_{\mathrm{cmd}})$ | Command after applying declared actuator limits | Same units as $\mathbf{u}$ |
| $\mathbf{K}_P,\mathbf{K}_I,\mathbf{K}_D$ | Proportional, integral, and derivative gain matrices | Chosen for dimensional consistency |
| $T_d$ | Command, sensing, or computation delay | $\mathrm{s}$ |
| $e_p,e_\theta$ | Position and heading tracking errors | $\mathrm{m},\mathrm{rad}$ |
| $\operatorname{RMSE}_p$ | Root-mean-square position error over a declared interval | $\mathrm{m}$ |
| $M_p,t_s$ | Peak overshoot and settling time | Declared output units, $\mathrm{s}$ |
| $E_u=\int\mathbf{u}^\mathsf{T}\mathbf{u}\,dt$ | Control-effort measure | Determined by the input units |
| $N_{\mathrm{viol}}$ | Number of declared constraint violations | Count |
